**1.006: Enter waits for your last words.**

- **Enter waits for the last words:** in the Hebrish voice keyboard, tapping Enter after you stop and before the last words are in now waits for them (up to 4 seconds), then sends. Your message no longer goes without its last words, and they no longer land in the next one. If they take longer, Enter goes through and the words are kept for Insert last. The floating mic can't do this: there the Enter belongs to the other app.
- **Fewer repeated words:** repeated words and false starts are cut ("I really wanted, wanted to go home" → "I really wanted to go home"). Words doubled on purpose stay doubled, never more than twice; numbers are left alone. Same rules as the desktop app since 1.007.
- **Voice Typing:** the Dictation screen is now Voice Typing.
- Not yet tested on a phone. arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
